name: Equities
description: Cash equities and equity indices: prices, returns, volumes, valuation, and risk.

metrics.name: total_return
metrics.description: Price return plus reinvested dividends over the period

metrics.name: adv
metrics.description: Average daily traded value over a trailing window

metrics.name: market_cap
metrics.description: Price times shares outstanding at a point in time

metrics.name: realized_volatility
metrics.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns

metrics.name: pe_ratio
metrics.description: Price divided by earnings per share

conventions.rule: Use split- and dividend-adjusted prices for returns; state the adjustment basis.
Index membership and fundamentals are point-in-time; use constituents as of each date, not today's list.
Annualize daily volatility with the square root of trading days (commonly 252); state the convention.

insight_rules.reason: Returns compound; use weight-times-return contribution only for a stated single period.

caveats.text: Delisted names drop out of current lists; historical screens need point-in-time universes.

chart_conventions.rule: Use a log scale for long price histories; use indexed-to-100 lines to compare securities.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
